_doc: Read by bin/i18n-*.php. 'protect' terms must appear unchanged in any translation whose English contains them. See plan/translations-1.8.2-handoff.md in wp-career-board.

glossary.job / job listing: a position an employer posts; one word used consistently
glossary.board: a job board on the site (a site can run several)
glossary.company: the business a job belongs to; one employer can run several
glossary.application: one candidate applying to one job
glossary.job alert: a saved search that emails new matching jobs
glossary.featured: a job or company promoted to the top
glossary.bookmark / saved: a job, company or resume kept for later
glossary.credits: the prepaid balance employers spend to post or feature jobs (money string)
glossary.hiring pipeline / stage: the columns an application moves through (Pro)
glossary.Open to Work: a candidate badge saying they are available
glossary.AI: use the locale's usual abbreviation (IA in French and Spanish, KI in German)
